get_candidate.title: Get a candidate
get_candidate.description: Read one Candidate record by its id and return the requested fields under data. Use search or query tools to find ids first; use get_entity for entity types without a dedicated tool, or get_entities to read several ids at once.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; nested to-one/to-many fields use parentheses, e.g. owner(id,firstName). * returns every field.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: The Candidate under data, with meta when requested.

create_candidate.title: Create a candidate
create_candidate.description: Create a new Candidate (PUT /entity/Candidate). Pass the field values as data; to-one associations are given as {"id": n} objects referencing existing records, and to-many associations cannot be set here (use add_to_many_association after). Returns changedEntityId of the new record. Call get_entity_meta for Candidate to see which fields are mandatory.

data.description: The Candidate field values, e.g. {"firstName":"Ada","owner":{"id":1}} (field names are Bullhorn's camelCase entity fields).

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType INSERT and the stored data.

update_candidate.title: Update a candidate
update_candidate.description: Update fields on an existing Candidate (POST /entity/Candidate/{id}); only the fields you pass change. Read-only fields are rejected. To soft-delete where Candidate supports it, pass {"isDeleted": true}.

data.description: The Candidate fields to change, e.g. {"status":"Active"}.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType UPDATE and the changed data.

search_candidates.title: Search candidates
search_candidates.description: Search Candidate records through Bullhorn's Lucene index with a Lucene query (e.g. isDeleted:0 AND status:Active). Fast for text and status filters; results carry a _score. Use query_candidates instead for exact JPQL conditions on database fields.

query.description: Lucene query, e.g. "lastName:Smith AND isDeleted:0" or "dateAdded:[20240101 TO *]".

sort.description: Field to sort by; ascending by default, prefix with - for descending, e.g. -dateAdded.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: A page of Candidate records under data, with total, start and count.

query_candidates.title: Query candidates
query_candidates.description: Query Candidate records from the database with a JPQL-style where clause (e.g. id > 100 AND isDeleted = false). Use this for exact field conditions, or search_candidates for Lucene text search. Use query_entities with POST semantics for very long where clauses.

where.description: SQL-like where clause on entity fields, e.g. "dateAdded > 1704067200000 AND owner.id = 5". Dates are epoch milliseconds.

order_by.description: Field to order by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -dateAdded.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: A page of Candidate records under data, with total, start and count.

Pass the field values as data; to-one associations are given as {"id": n} objects referencing existing records, and to-many associations cannot be set here (use add_to_many_association after). Returns changedEntityId of the new record. Call get_entity_meta for Task to see which fields are mandatory.

data.description: The Task field values, e.g. {"firstName":"Ada","owner":{"id":1}} (field names are Bullhorn's camelCase entity fields).

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType INSERT and the stored data.

update_task.title: Update a task
update_task.description: Update fields on an existing Task (POST /entity/Task/{id}); only the fields you pass change. Read-only fields are rejected. To soft-delete where Task supports it, pass {"isDeleted": true}.

data.description: The Task fields to change, e.g. {"status":"Active"}.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType UPDATE and the changed data.

search_tasks.title: Search tasks
search_tasks.description: Search Task records through Bullhorn's Lucene index with a Lucene query (e.g. isDeleted:0 AND status:Active). Fast for text and status filters; results carry a _score. Use query_tasks instead for exact JPQL conditions on database fields.

query.description: Lucene query, e.g. "lastName:Smith AND isDeleted:0" or "dateAdded:[20240101 TO *]".

sort.description: Field to sort by; ascending by default, prefix with - for descending, e.g. -dateAdded.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: A page of Task records under data, with total, start and count.

query_tasks.title: Query tasks
query_tasks.description: Query Task records from the database with a JPQL-style where clause (e.g. id > 100 AND isDeleted = false). Use this for exact field conditions, or search_tasks for Lucene text search. Use query_entities with POST semantics for very long where clauses.

where.description: SQL-like where clause on entity fields, e.g. "dateAdded > 1704067200000 AND owner.id = 5". Dates are epoch milliseconds.

order_by.description: Field to order by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -dateAdded.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: A page of Task records under data, with total, start and count.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; nested to-one/to-many fields use parentheses, e.g. owner(id,firstName). * returns every field.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: The Lead under data, with meta when requested.

data.description: The Lead field values, e.g. {"firstName":"Ada","owner":{"id":1}} (field names are Bullhorn's camelCase entity fields).

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType INSERT and the stored data.

output.description: A page of Opportunity records under data, with total, start and count.

Use this for exact field conditions, or search_opportunities for Lucene text search. Use query_entities with POST semantics for very long where clauses.

where.description: SQL-like where clause on entity fields, e.g. "dateAdded > 1704067200000 AND owner.id = 5". Dates are epoch milliseconds.

order_by.description: Field to order by; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -dateAdded.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: A page of Opportunity records under data, with total, start and count.

get_entity.title: Get any entity
get_entity.description: Read one record of any Bullhorn entity type by id, returning the chosen fields under data. Prefer the dedicated get_candidate, get_job_order etc. for the major entities; use this for the rest (CorporateUser, Skill, Tearsheet, Sendout...). For effective-dated entities pass effective_on.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields, with nested fields in parentheses; * for all.

effective_on.description: For effective-dated entities (e.g. Location), the date (YYYY-MM-DD) whose version to return; defaults to today.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

show_editable.description: When true, each record carries an _editable flag saying whether the current user may edit it.

output.description: The record under data.

get_entities.title: Get several entities
get_entities.description: Read several records of one entity type in a single call by a comma-separated id list; returns the records that were found as an array under data (404 only if none exist).

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return; * for all.

output.description: The found records under data.

create_entity.title: Create any entity
create_entity.description: Create a record of any entity type that supports insert (PUT /entity/{type}); returns changedEntityId. Prefer the dedicated create_* tools for the major entities. For effective-dated entities include effectiveDate.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

data.description: Field values for the new record; to-one associations as {"id": n}.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType and data.

update_entity.title: Update any entity
update_entity.description: Update fields on a record of any entity type (POST /entity/{type}/{id}); only the fields passed change. Soft-delete with {"isDeleted": true} where supported; for effective-dated entities include versionID to edit a version instead of creating one.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

data.description: The fields to change.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType and data.

delete_entity.title: Delete an entity
delete_entity.description: Delete a record (DELETE /entity/{type}/{id}). Depending on the type this is a hard delete or a soft delete; immutable types such as Country, Skill or State cannot be deleted. For entities that only soft-delete through isDeleted, use update_entity instead.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType and data.

list_entity_versions.title: List effective-dated versions
list_entity_versions.description: List every version of an effective-dated entity record (e.g. Location), each with its effectiveDate and versionID. Use get_entity with effective_on to read the version in force on a date.

entity_type.description: The effective-dated entity type, e.g. Location.

output.description: The versions under data.

list_to_many.title: List a to-many association
list_to_many.description: Page through the records linked to one entity through a to-many field, e.g. a Candidate's submissions, a JobOrder's placements or a ClientCorporation's clientContacts.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

association.description: The to-many field name, e.g. submissions, placements, clientContacts, primarySkills, categories.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields of the associated records.

order_by.description: Field to order by; prefix with - for descending.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

add_to_many.title: Add to-many associations
add_to_many.description: Associate existing records with an entity through a to-many field, e.g. add skills to a Candidate's primarySkills or categories to a JobOrder. Fails if any of the ids is already associated.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

association.description: The to-many field name, e.g. primarySkills, categories, specialties.

ids.description: Comma-separated ids of the records to associate.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType and data.

remove_to_many.title: Remove to-many associations
remove_to_many.description: Disassociate records from an entity's to-many field. The associated records themselves are not deleted; only the link is removed.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

output.description: changedEntityType, changedEntityId, changeType and data.

query_association.title: Query an association in bulk
query_association.description: Return the associated records for many parent ids at once (POST /association/{entity}/{field}), e.g. the categories of 1000 candidates in one call. Use list_to_many for a single parent.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

association.description: The association field name, e.g. categories.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields of the associated records.

count.description: Maximum associations to return (up to 10000).

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

search_entities.title: Search any entity
search_entities.description: Lucene search over any indexed entity type (Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Lead, Note, Opportunity, Placement, Task). The query goes in a POST body, so it also suits queries over 7500 characters. Prefer the per-entity search_* tools for short queries.

entity_type.description: The indexed entity type.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

query_entities.title: Query any entity
query_entities.description: JPQL-style database query over any entity type, with the where clause sent in a POST body (works for where clauses over 7500 characters). Use for entities without a dedicated query_* tool such as CorporateUser, Sendout, Tearsheet or PlacementCommission.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

where.description: Where clause, e.g. "isDeleted = false AND owner.id = 5".

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

total_only.description: Return only the total count, no records.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

find.title: Quick find across entities
find.description: Bullhorn's quick-find: one free-text term matched across ClientContact, JobOrder, Candidate, ClientCorporation and (when enabled) Lead and Opportunity. Good for 'who or what is X'; use search_* tools for structured filters.

query.description: The text to look for, e.g. a name, email or phone number.

meta.description: How much field metadata to return alongside the data: off (none), basic (field names, types, labels) or full (adds associated-entity metadata).

output.description: Matches under data, each with entityType, entityId and title.

list_department_entities.title: List department records
list_department_entities.description: List the Candidates, ClientContacts, Placements or Notes owned by the current user's departments (or the given department_ids). Candidate and Note accept a Lucene query and sort; the others take a where clause.

department_ids.description: Comma-separated department ids; defaults to the user's departments.

count.description: Records per page (default 20, max 500).

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

list_my_entities.title: List my records
list_my_entities.description: List the Candidates, ClientContacts, Placements or Notes owned by the current API user. Candidate and Note accept a Lucene query and sort; the others take a where clause.

count.description: Records per page (default 20, max 500).

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

list_corporation_notes.title: List all notes for a corporation
list_corporation_notes.description: Return every Note tied to a ClientCorporation and its contacts (GET /allCorpNotes), which a plain query on Note cannot gather in one call.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.

list_entity_types.title: List entity types
list_entity_types.description: List every entity type the REST API exposes, each with its metaUrl. Follow up with get_entity_meta to see an entity's fields.

output.description: Array of {entity, metaUrl, label}.

get_entity_meta.title: Get entity metadata
get_entity_meta.description: Describe an entity type's fields: names, types, data specs, labels, whether required, option lists and associations. Use before create/update to learn mandatory and custom fields (customText1 etc.) and their labels.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

meta.description: basic or full (full adds associated-entity metadata).

output.description: entity, label, dateLastModified and fields[].

list_option_types.title: List option types
list_option_types.description: List the option types available (e.g. Country, State, Skill, Category, CandidateStatus, JobOrderStatus), each with its URL. Use get_options for the values.

output.description: The option types.

get_options.title: Get option values
get_options.description: List the selectable values for one option type, as value/label pairs (e.g. the valid Candidate statuses or the State list for a country).

options_type.description: Option type, e.g. Country, State, Skill, Category, CandidateStatus.

filter.description: Only values whose label matches this text.

country.description: For State, the country id to list states of.

count.description: Values per page (default 20, max 300).

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: Value/label pairs under data.

get_entitlements.title: Get entitlements
get_entitlements.description: Return the current user's entitlements (permissions) on one entity type, e.g. VIEW, ADD, EDIT, DELETE variants, to check before attempting a write.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

output.description: Array of entitlement names.

list_settings.title: List settings
list_settings.description: List every readable setting with name, valueUrl, valueType and isArray. Use get_settings to read values.

output.description: Setting metadata.

get_settings.title: Get settings
get_settings.description: Read the values of one or more named settings, e.g. userId, corporationId, corporationName, allDeptIds, privateLabelId, timeZone. Useful to learn who the API user is.

output.description: An object keyed by setting name.

ping.title: Ping the session
ping.description: Check the BhRestToken session is alive and return sessionExpires (epoch ms). Cheap connection check.

output.description: sessionExpires timestamp.

list_mass_update_entities.title: List mass-updatable entities
list_mass_update_entities.description: List the entity types that support mass update. Use get_mass_update_fields for what can be changed on one.

output.description: Entity type names.

get_mass_update_fields.title: Get mass-update fields
get_mass_update_fields.description: List the properties of an entity type that mass update can set, with the entitlements each requires.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

output.description: Updatable properties and entitlements.

mass_update.title: Mass update records
mass_update.description: Set the same property values on up to 10000 records of one type in one call. Not individually reversible; check get_mass_update_fields first. Returns the count updated.

entity_type.description: The Bullhorn entity type name, case-sensitive, e.g. Candidate, JobOrder, Placement, CorporateUser, Skill, Category, Department, Tearsheet, PlacementCommission, Sendout.

update.description: The body: ids (array of up to 10000 record ids) plus the property values to set, e.g. {"ids":[1,2,3],"status":"Inactive"}.

output.description: {count}

list_file_attachments.title: List file attachments
list_file_attachments.description: List the files attached to a record (name, type, contentType, description, dateAdded, id). Use get_file to download one.

entity_type.description: Entity type the file is attached to, e.g. Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Opportunity, Placement.

output.description: Attachments under data.

get_file.title: Download a file
get_file.description: Download one attached file as base64 (File.fileContent, with name and contentType). Find file ids with list_file_attachments.

entity_type.description: Entity type the file is attached to, e.g. Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Opportunity, Placement.

output.description: File with fileContent (base64), name and contentType.

upload_file.title: Attach a file
upload_file.description: Attach a file (base64) to a record such as a Candidate's resume or a Placement contract. Returns the new fileId. To parse a resume into Candidate fields, use parse_resume_to_candidate instead.

entity_type.description: Entity type the file is attached to, e.g. Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Opportunity, Placement.

external_id.description: External identifier for the file, e.g. portfolio or a source-system id.

file_extension.description: Extension without the dot, e.g. pdf.

type.description: Attachment type label, e.g. Resume or Cover Letter.

output.description: fileId and changeType.

update_file.title: Replace a file
update_file.description: Replace an attached file's content and properties. Returns no body on success.

entity_type.description: Entity type the file is attached to, e.g. Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Opportunity, Placement.

external_id.description: External identifier for the file, e.g. portfolio or a source-system id.

file_extension.description: Extension without the dot, e.g. pdf.

type.description: Attachment type label, e.g. Resume or Cover Letter.

output.description: Empty on success.

delete_file.title: Delete a file
delete_file.description: Remove an attachment from a record. This is a soft delete in Bullhorn (the file stays on the server) but it disappears from the record.

entity_type.description: Entity type the file is attached to, e.g. Candidate, ClientContact, ClientCorporation, JobOrder, Opportunity, Placement.

output.description: fileId and changeType DELETED.

delete_headshot.title: Delete a headshot
delete_headshot.description: Remove the headshot photo from a Candidate, ClientContact or CorporateUser (soft delete).

entity_type.description: Entity type.

output.description: fileId and changeType DELETED.

upload_headshot.title: Upload a headshot
upload_headshot.description: Set the headshot photo on a Candidate or ClientContact from base64 image content.

entity_type.description: Entity type.

external_id.description: External identifier for the file, e.g. portfolio or a source-system id.

output.description: fileId and changeType.

parse_resume_to_candidate.title: Parse resume text into a candidate
parse_resume_to_candidate.description: Parse resume text (sent as JSON) and return a candidate structure (candidate, candidateEducation, candidateWorkHistory, skillList) without saving anything; then create_candidate with the result.

resume.description: The resume content as plain text or HTML.

populate_description.description: Fill the candidate description as html or text.

output.description: Parsed candidate, education, work history and skills.

parse_resume_to_hr_xml.title: Parse resume text to HR-XML
parse_resume_to_hr_xml.description: Parse resume text into an HR-XML document. Saves nothing; use parse_resume_to_candidate for Bullhorn-shaped output.

output.description: HR-XML of the parsed resume.

convert_resume_to_text.title: Convert resume to text
convert_resume_to_text.description: Convert resume content to plain text (convertToTextViaJson). Use convert_resume_to_html for HTML output.

output.description: The converted text.

convert_resume_to_html.title: Convert resume to HTML
convert_resume_to_html.description: Convert resume content to HTML (convertToHtmlViaJson). Use convert_resume_to_text for plain text output.

output.description: The converted HTML.

create_event_subscription.title: Subscribe to entity events
create_event_subscription.description: Create (or replace) an event subscription that records INSERTED/UPDATED/DELETED events for the named entity types; poll it with get_subscription_events.

subscription_id.description: Your subscription id, any name you choose, e.g. candidateChanges.

event_types.description: Comma-separated event types from INSERTED, UPDATED, DELETED.

output.description: subscriptionId, lastRequestId, createdOn, jmsSelector.

get_subscription_events.title: Get subscription events
get_subscription_events.description: Fetch the next batch of events for a subscription. Events are consumed on read; pass request_id to re-read an earlier batch. Returns nothing when no events are waiting.
get_subscription_events.notes: Reading events is not idempotent: a plain read advances the subscription.

subscription_id.description: Your subscription id, any name you choose, e.g. candidateChanges.

list_saved_searches.title: List saved searches visible to the user
list_saved_searches.description: List saved searches visible to the user, optionally filtered by index type or linked entity. Use get_saved_search for one.

type.description: Filter by index type, e.g. Candidate.

order_by.description: id or name with +/- prefix; default -id.

count.description: How many records to return per page. Bullhorn caps this at 500.

start.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return, for paging.

output.description: A page of records under data, with total, start and count.
